Additional Information
Staking Options
: At launch, users can stake EIGEN to secure EigenDA, with more Actively Validated Services (AVSs) expected soon.
Token Transferability
: Initially, EIGEN tokens are non-transferable to allow time for further product development and community feedback.
Unstaking Period
: Unstaking EIGEN includes a 24-day waiting period to uphold essential security properties of the ecosystem.
